core_categories: Retail; Groceries; Health and Wellness; General Merchandise; E-commerce
specialty_focus: Walmart is a global omni-channel retailer operating on a high-volume, low-margin model, offering a vast assortment of consumer goods through physical stores and e-commerce. Its core specialty focus is Everyday Low Prices (EDLP), blending trusted national brands with high-value private-label alternatives. It does not specifically specialize in wearable medical devices, but its health and wellness category includes pharmacy, OTC medicines, and personal care.
